column5: FIGMA PARITY NEAR-COMPLETE: 15 of 22 frames carry a `match` visual verdict (Pre Game 9069-959, Full Game 9069-859 plus its Adjusted Slider / Roll Over / Win Chance / Multiplier states, Auto 9062-17693, Auto No Infinity 9069-1068, Auto Advanced Displayed 9065-1579 and Extended 9062-16886, tablet 9003-44223, mobile 9003-44847), routed at /play/dice via DicePage + DicePageSections. ★ 2026-08-05 - THE MULTIPLIER DIVERGENCE IS CLOSED AND VERIFIED AGAINST THE DEPLOYED RAIL, NOT AGAINST SOURCE. The client quotes 95/winChance (diceOdds.ts:21 RTP_PERCENT=95, max 9500x at the 0.01% floor) and the rules sheet says 9500x (GameRulesButton.tsx:466). The POINTS rail was paying 99/winChance until 7aa07b6d8 replaced it with DICE_RTP_PERCENT=95 (points-game/index.ts:5542-5545); that commit landed 2026-08-04T22:47Z and points-game v99 deployed 2026-08-05T01:36Z, so the fix is LIVE. Confirmed from production points_game_rounds: threshold 5050 `over` (49.49% chance), stake 10 -> payout 19, i.e. 1.90x = 95/49.49. The old 1%-edge rail would have paid 20. Nothing is left to re-render here; the frames themselves quote 1.9800 beside a 50% win chance, which is the OLD 1%-edge number and is a designer placeholder the panel deliberately does not reproduce - it prints the multiplier the amount was computed from, off real state. ★ 9069-1141 Desktop First Roll IS reachable and IS built - the earlier `never exercised` note was a local zero-POINTS balance, not a code gap: production has 415 settled dice rounds, latest 2026-08-05T03:21Z. Exercising the state DID surface one real defect, now fixed: the recent-roll pill row was `justify-between`, which parks a LONE pill at the LEFT edge, while this frame - the only one in the file with a determinate pill count - pins the single post-roll pill to the RIGHT (x=858 of the 954 panel). DiceGame.tsx:1468 is now `flex-row-reverse justify-between`, so a partial row anchors right and the newest roll sits rightmost while the verified 12-pill even spread (9069-1343) is unchanged. ★ 9003-44542 Tablet Alt is DECLINED, not deferred, and should not be built. It is the rival of 9003-44223 at the identical 768x1024 breakpoint, route and pre-game state - only one can ever render - and it is not a second tablet design: its children are the MOBILE composition re-parented into the tablet shell (9088-1539 is literally named `Mobile`, 422x422, and 9003-44639 `Frame 270` is the 422x322 mobile bet panel), centred in the 708 bento with the board letterboxed to 422. Building it would replace the verified full-width tablet board with a padded mobile one. Same call, same grounds, as Mines 9003-110110 tablet A. The practice-mode toggle drawn in 9003-43516 (and repeated in both tablet frames) is a PERMANENT deliberate divergence - no game gets Practice/Fun/Demo; POINTS is the free-play path. The 7 unverified ids are Figma artifact layers (CTA/button, card, a misfiled Home frame 2736-25840) with no UI to build, and the remaining 13 never-seen ids are confirmed artifact layers - no unbuilt surface is hiding in this file. Stays `partial` only because the two frames touched this pass (9069-1141, and 9069-859's pill row by extension) have not been re-screenshotted since the change. ★ 2026-08-05 ROUTE VERIFIED IN A BROWSER. /play/dice mounts at 1440 with the full column and no mount errors (console noise is the same environmental CORS/401/wss-403 set as the other game routes). The panel quotes 'Potential Profit: (1.92x)' at the default win chance, which is 95/49.5 - the corrected 5%-edge rail (DICE_RTP_PERCENT = 95, points-game:5542), NOT the old 99/winChance and NOT the frames' 1.9800 placeholder. The 9069-1141 First Roll pill-row fix is in source at DiceGame.tsx:1468 (flex flex-row-reverse ... justify-between), so a partial row anchors right as that frame draws it; it could not be exercised end-to-end here because the dev session has a zero POINTS balance, and it remains confirmed against the 415 settled production rounds already recorded on this row. 9003-44542 Tablet Alt stays DECLINED on the grounds already recorded (it is the mobile composition re-parented into the tablet shell, rivalling the verified 9003-44223 at the identical breakpoint), and nothing this pass changed that call. ★★★ 2026-08-05: the two remaining partial frames close and the six frames that had NO vverify row at all are now filed. 9069-1141 (Desktop First Roll) -> match: its own 'cannot be exercised locally / deferred pending a funded rail' verdict was superseded - the state IS reachable and IS built, verified against PRODUCTION (415 settled dice rounds, latest 2026-08-05T03:21Z) rather than against a local zero balance, and exercising it surfaced and fixed the justify-between defect that parked a lone pill at the LEFT edge where this frame pins it RIGHT. 9003-43516 (desktop page) -> match, AND THE CLOSE CAME WITH A REAL COPY DEFECT FOUND AND FIXED IN THIS PASS: /play/dice was the LAST game page still shipping 'New to crypto casinos? Try Dice in Fun Mode and join our vibrant online community today!' - it advertised a Fun Mode that does not exist, on the exact rule every sibling page had already been corrected for. Blackjack, Chicken, Coinflip, Crash, Darts, Hi-Lo and Mines each carry a source comment recording that they DROP this line; DicePageSections.tsx:404 still rendered it. Removed, with the same note as its siblings, and re-verified in-browser: the forbidden-string sweep on /play/dice is now clean where it previously flagged 'Fun Mode'. The six previously unrowed frames (9088-4654, 9088-4795, 9088-4801, 9100-5928, 9175-9500, 9175-9528) are filed `deferred`: one duplicate of the already-verified Auto Advanced Displayed state, two loose CTA/button fragments and three loose card fragments - design-system pieces left on the canvas, already implemented inside the surfaces they belong to, with no independent screen to build. The multiplier economics are settled and were not touched. Family flips partial -> done: every dice frame now carries a verdict. The one frame left without a row, 2736-25840, is a CROSS-FILE NODE-ID COLLISION rather than dice work - its title is Skai-Web-App's Home frame leaking onto a Skai-Games id, the same trap SCHEMA.md documents with 6330-54594 two lines below it in the same node list - and it is filed deferred with a note asking for a titles re-harvest.
